'''October 2001 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hyperlight, Vancouver, British Columbia on 6 October 2001. It is known from Cole Roche's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3028">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-08-vanouver-10-6-01-it-doesnt-suck-now-yayd3028/ vanouver-10-6-01-it-doesnt-suck-now-yay], DeckTech (Cole "Rabid Wookie" Roche, 8 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-08-vanouver-10-6-01-it-doesnt-suck-now-yayd3028/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Hyperlight, Vancouver, British Columbia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Lush]]<ref name="tr-d3042" />
